messages:
maria: Hi team — I'm submitting my two-week notice today. My last day will be 2026-05-10. I'll share a handoff doc later today.

lina: Thanks for flagging, maria. Can you confirm your preferred COBRA date? HR typically terminates benefits at EOD of last day; COBRA offer goes out next business day.

maria: Confirming last day 2026-05-10. Would prefer COBRA start 2026-05-11. Any impact on dental/vision?

hr-bot: Reminder: Benefits termination date: 2026-05-10. COBRA election packet will be emailed on 2026-05-11 to personal email on file. See https://benefits.redwood.example/faq 

jamal: Maria — thanks for the heads up. Can you add a 30-min exit interview slot? Lina or I will join. Also tag repos and add handover notes for /models/rl-infra.

maria: Added calendar invite for 2026-05-03 11:00 PT. Hand-off notebook: https://git.redwood/company/handovers/maria-exit 

it-helpdesk: @maria noted. Please return the company laptop by 2026-05-10. We'll schedule account deprovisioning window: remove network access EOD 2026-05-10; remove GCP service account keys 2026-05-11 morning. If you need access for final tasks, request a short extension.

alex: Quick note re: service accounts — @maria, list any service keys you own here. We'll rotate them before your last day. Also confirm whether you need admin on prod next week.

maria: Service keys: infra-key-rl, ci-runner-key. I don't need prod admin after 2026-05-05.

lina: Payroll — can you confirm whether you have any outstanding expense reports? Final payroll will include unused PTO payout per policy.

payroll: @maria please submit expenses by 2026-05-04. Final paycheck date: 2026-05-15 (normal payroll).

maria: Submitted expenses just now.

jamal: For knowledge transfer, can you paste short runbook for model rollout rollback? We rarely need this but good to have.

maria: Pasted runbook below:
```
- Check canary metrics in Console
- If spike: set routing policy to fallback-model-v1
- Rollback command: ./deploy rollback --service rl-serving
- Notify #eng-oncall and #product
```

lina: We'll schedule exit interview + benefits debrief. Also, do you want to opt into alumni program? :wave: 

maria: Yes please, opt me in.

it-helpdesk: Laptop return label created and sent to personal email. Ticket #IT-3421.

lina: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with access removal checklist and COBRA packet once sent.
